assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Ten data-dependent MS/MS spectra of most intense ions were acquired in the LTQ-XL ion trap using CID
labeling: comparative analysis of the cross-linked peptides and monolinks using label-free quantitation
quantification: The acquired spectra from biological triplicate were loaded (Thermo raw files) into the Progenesis QI for Proteomics software (version 1.05156.29278) for label-free quantitation.
enrichment: The DSS-modified GPR110-HA was pulled down with HA antibody
Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: cross-link mass-shift, 138.06808 Da; monolink mass-shift, 156.07864 Da; reactive amino acid, K

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study using DSS to probe the 3D structure of GPR110. While not a traditional 'complexome' (interactome) study, CXMS is routed via complexome/structural modifiers in Stage 4. The search parameters explicitly include cross-link and monolink mass shifts for Lysine.

organism: The acquired MS/MS data were searched against the NCBInr human database
cell_lines: HEK293 (American Type Culture Collection) or GloResponseTM CRE-luc2P HEK293 reporter cell line (Promega) were cultured
scope: The DSS-modified GPR110-HA was pulled down with HA antibody and the DSS-modified monomeric protein was separated by SDS-PAGE and subjected to liquid chromatography-mass spectrometric analysis after in-gel tryptic digestion
The cell lysate was incubated with 40 µL of HA antibody (Santa Cruz Biotech., Cat #:7392) overnight followed by additional 4-h incubation with 40 µL Dynabeads protein G beads at 4 °C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on GPR110-HA protein that was specifically immunopurified (pulled down) from HEK293 cell lysates using an HA antibody and protein G beads, followed by SDS-PAGE and in-gel digestion. Therefore, the analyzed material is an affinity-purified protein, not a whole cell lysate.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) to compare the conformational state of GPR110 between an activated state (synaptamide) and unstimulated states (DMSO vehicle and OEA analog).

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses label-free quantitation (LFQ) with an LTQ-Orbitrap XL in DDA mode (top 10 most intense ions).

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Explicit use of disuccinimidyl suberate (DSS) for chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (CXMS) to probe 3D structure.

workflow: Cross-linking of expressed GPR110 was carried out in cells with or without synaptamide treatment using disuccinimidyl suberate (DSS)
The cross-linked lysine pairs were identified by xQuest software
acquired spectra from biological triplicate were loaded (Thermo raw files) into the Progenesis QI for Proteomics software (version 1.05156.29278) for label-free quantitation
differential: Significant changes of the cross-linked peptides were based on p ≤ 0.05 (unpair Student’s t-test) and 1.5 fold-change (synatamide-treated vs control)

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The analysis is highly site-specific, focusing on the relative abundance of specific cross-linked lysine pairs (e.g., K398-K438 and K783-K852) to infer conformational changes. Standard protein-level LFQ is used as a normalization baseline for the site-level cross-link quantification.
